texts.zh:
[silo_fire_planet_targeted.GetName]上一处资源储仓的电力故障导致了该仓储设施发生严重火灾。

灭火措施临时发生了故障，储存在此处的大部分资源付之一炬。储仓也受损得无法修复了。
texts.en:
An electrical malfunction in a resource silo on [silo_fire_planet_targeted.GetName] resulted in a massive fire within the storage facility.

The fire suppression measures had temporarily malfunctioned, and a significant proportion of the resources stored within were damaged in the blaze. The silo itself is damaged beyond repair.

texts.zh:
[silo_fire_starbase_targeted.Fleet.System.GetName]中[silo_fire_starbase_targeted.GetStarbaseOrWayStation]的恒星基地上一处资源储仓的电力故障导致了该仓储设施发生严重火灾。

灭火措施临时发生了故障，储存在此处的大部分资源付之一炬。储仓也受损得无法修复了。
texts.en:
An electrical malfunction in a resource silo on the [silo_fire_starbase_targeted.GetStarbaseOrWayStation] of [silo_fire_starbase_targeted.Fleet.System.GetName] resulted in a massive fire within the storage facility.

The fire suppression measures had temporarily malfunctioned, and a significant proportion of the resources stored within were damaged in the blaze. The silo itself is damaged beyond repair.
